# compute normal density function

compute normal density function

## Usage

``` r
density_function(x, mean = 0, sd = 1)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  a vector of values at which the density is evaluated

- mean:

  mean for normal distribution this should be set to 0

- sd:

  standard deviation for normal distribution that should be set to 1

## Note

this function should return the same result as the stats::dnorm
function\
the literal 2.71828 is accurate to 6 significant digits only and shifts
the\
EAP estimate in the 7th decimal so exp(1) is used instead

## Examples

``` r
v<-seq(-3,3,by=.001)
plot(y=density_function(x=v),x=v)

data.frame(x1=dnorm(v),x2=density_function(v))
```
